sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this Borrowed object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: WEBPAY011 explicitly closes this owned in-memory source before calling render. The exact close count of one and retained closed state are explicit checks.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The unit fixture owns this Executor and deliberately avoids implicit unbounded close. Each site calls shutdownNow and checks its actual finite termination in finally.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
